'''Frond Island''' (Japanese: '''ヤシ島''' ''Yashi Island'') is the eleventh island {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} visited during their travels on the [[Decolore Islands]].

Their ship docked at Frond Island, but the group rented a boat and spent most of their time on the {{OBP|Deserted Island|BW135}}, which was said to be filled with treasure.
